items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Oh there was no name of the band, it was just Harry King's band up in the dance hall

ctx.x: Well listen, when you first went to New York, what band was that you played with? You said at this dancing place?

Oh there was no name of the band, it was just Harry King's band up in the dance hall, you know what I mean? And then later on, like I said, I went to work in the speakeasies for a while, and then after the crash came, the speakeasies got kind of bad, and I got a chance to go to White Plains, you see. I worked at a new group, a nice little band up there, a guy from New York to come and sit in, and they used to listen to Louis records, between sets all the time, they'd hear the record players, all the guys were…
Who was the band? There was no name.
